title.zh: Tesla's Profit Drops 43% as Musk Starts Building Robots and Plans to Sell Driverless Cabs
title.en: Tesla's Profit Drops 43% as Musk Starts Building Robots and Plans to Sell Driverless Cabs

current_state.zh: Tesla's quarterly net income fell 43% to $787 million as it ramped research and capital spending, while also starting Optimus humanoid robot production and targeting Cybercab customer deliveries by the end of 2026.
current_state.en: Tesla's quarterly net income fell 43% to $787 million as it ramped research and capital spending, while also starting Optimus humanoid robot production and targeting Cybercab customer deliveries by the end of 2026.
